resources.string: Ukunyakaza nokuthinta
Ukunyakaza kwe-VoiceOver

Ungasebenzisa ukunyakaza kwe-VoiceOver ku-iPhone. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Isakhiwo sokunyakaza, bese ukhetha okuthi Ukunyakaza kwe-VoiceOver. Isakhiwo ngasinye sigcina izinguquko ozenze ekunyakazeni kwaleso sakhiwo. Esakhiweni se-VoiceOver, ukuswayipha ngeminwe emibili kuqalisa imiyalo ye-SandFly. Ukuze uvule noma uvale lokhu, sebenzisa okuthi Phatha ukuswayipha ngeminwe emibili ku-SandFly.
Ukuthepha ngemuva

Ungaqalisa imiyalo ngokuthepha kabili noma kathathu ngemuva kwedivayisi. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, bese ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuthepha ngemuva, ukhethe okuthi Thepha kabili ngemuva noma Thepha kathathu ngemuva. Ukuze ushintshe ukuthi ukuthepha kufanele kuqine kangakanani, sebenzisa okuthi Ukuzwela kokuthepha ngemuva.
Ukuswayipha ngasemaphethelweni

Ungashelelisa umunwe owodwa ngasonqenqemeni lwesikrini: phezulu noma phansi onqenqemeni lwesokunxele noma lwesokudla, noma ngakwesokunxele noma ngakwesokudla ngasonqenqemeni olungaphezulu noma olungezansi. Qala khona kanye onqenqemeni, bese ugcina umunwe wakho useduze nalo. Ukuze wabele imiyalo, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, bese ngaphansi kokuthi Imiphetho, ukhethe ukunyakaza okufana nokuthi Swayiphela phezulu ngasonqenqemeni lwesokunxele. Ukuze uskrole ama-app ngomunwe owodwa ngasonqenqemeni esikhundleni salokho, vula okuthi Skrola ngomunwe owodwa ngasonqenqemeni lwesokunxele, noma iswishi yolunye unqenqema, ngaphansi kokuthi Imiphetho.
Amamenyu asemaphethelweni

Unqenqema lwesokunxele nolwesokudla ngamunye lungaba yimenyu enemiyalo efika ku-10. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Imenyu yonqenqema lwesokunxele noma Imenyu yonqenqema lwesokudla, vula okuthi Sebenzisa unqenqema lwesokunxele njengemenyu noma Sebenzisa unqenqema lwesokudla njengemenyu, bese ukhetha okuthi Engeza umyalo. Ukuze usebenzise imenyu, qala khona kanye onqenqemeni bese ushelelisa umunwe phezulu noma phansi ngalo. I-SandFly ithi umyalo ngamunye lapho umunwe wakho ufika kuwo, futhi ukuphakamisa umunwe kuqalisa umyalo.
Ukucindezela okhiye bevolumu

Ungabela imiyalo ukucindezela kabili, ukucindezela kathathu nokucindezela isikhathi eside kokhiye bevolumu. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Okhiye bevolumu, bese ukhetha ukucindezela, njengokuthi Ukucindezela kabili inkinobho yokukhulisa ivolumu. Ukhiye ongenakho ukucindezela okwabelwe ushintsha ivolumu njengakuqala.
Bamba ukuze ukhansele

Ngokuthi Phakamisa ukuze uvule, ukuphakamisa umunwe wakho onqenqemeni lwesikrini manje akuvuli lutho. Ukuze ukuphakamisa kungavuli lutho ngemuva kokubamba umunwe wakho entweni, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuthinta, Bamba ukuze ukhansele, bese ukhetha isikhathi.
Thepha ukuze uvule

Ukuthepha okusheshayo kwenza into engaphansi komunwe wakho isebenze ngaphandle kokuyigxila kuqala. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuthinta, bese uvula okuthi Thepha ukuze uvule. Leli sethingi lidinga i-Android 13 noma kamuva.
Inkulumo nomsindo
Isilinganisi somsindo senkulumo

Ungashintsha umsindo wenkulumo ngesilinganisi somsindo esinamabhendi angu-12. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Isilinganisi somsindo, bese ukhetha okuthi Ukusetha ngaphambilini, noma uhambise isilayidi sebhendi ngayinye. Iphrofayili yezwi ngayinye inesilinganisi somsindo sayo, esikrinini sephrofayili. Isilinganisi somsindo sidinga okuthi Umsindo wokubambezeleka okuphansi, kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukukhipha umsindo.
Gcina inkulumo efonini ngenkathi kusakazwa isikrini

Ukuze ugcine inkulumo nemisindo ye-SandFly efonini ngenkathi usakaza noma ufanisa isikrini, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukukhipha umsindo, bese uvula okuthi Gcina inkulumo efonini ngenkathi kusakazwa isikrini. Okuqoshiwe kwesikrini ngemuva kwalokho akunawo umsindo we-SandFly. Leli sethingi lidinga i-Android 10 noma kamuva.
Memezela uma ibhethri ligcwele
Ukuze uzwe okuthi \"Ibhethri ligcwele\" lapho ibhethri ligcwele ngenkathi ishaja ixhunyiwe, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, I-Verbosity, bese uvula okuthi Memezela uma ibhethri ligcwele.
Izwi lezimemezelo zesikhathi
Ukuze ukhethe izwi elisho isikhathi ngesikhawu esisethiwe, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Izaziso, Isifinyezo nesikhathi, Izwi. Ungakhetha izwi lezaziso, izwi le-SandFly noma iphrofayili yezwi.
Ukukhuluma ngenkathi idivayisi ikhiyiwe

I-app ekusekelayo lokhu ingakhuluma nge-SandFly ngenkathi idivayisi ikhiyiwe, uma usuyivumele ngokwehlukile. Ukuze ushintshe lokhu kamuva, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Vumela ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhulume, bese usebenzisa iswishi eqanjwe ngegama le-app, njengokuthi Tasker ngenkathi idivayisi ikhiyiwe.
I-Braille
Okhiye besibonisi se-braille

Ungashintsha okhiye bomyalo ngamunye wesibonisi se-braille, futhi unikeze okhiye besibonisi imiyalo eqaliswa ukunyakaza. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, I-Braille, Isibonisi se-braille, Imiyalo yesibonisi se-braille, khetha umyalo, bese ukhetha okuthi Shintsha izinkinobho. Bese ucindezela okhiye abasha esibonisini.
Isichazamazwi se-braille

Ungashintsha indlela umbhalo oboniswa ngayo esibonisini se-braille, kuwo wonke ama-app noma ku-app eyodwa. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, I-Braille, Isichazamazwi se-braille, bese ukhetha okuthi Engeza okufakwa esikhundleni.
Fihla ikhibhodi esesikrinini

Ukuze amanye amakhibhodi asesikrinini ahlale efihliwe ngenkathi kuxhunywe isibonisi se-braille, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, I-Braille, Isibonisi se-braille, bese uvula okuthi Fihla ikhibhodi esesikrinini.
Ukusesha i-emoji

Ekhibhodini ye-braille, bamba amachashazi 4, 5 no-6, bese uswayiphela kwesokudla. Thayipha amagama egama le-emoji nge-braille engafinyeziwe. Ukuze uhambe phakathi kwama-emoji afanayo, swayiphela phansi noma phezulu ngomunwe owodwa. Ukuze ufake i-emoji, swayiphela kwesokudla ngeminwe emibili.
Buyekeza ukuma kwamachashazi ngesandla esisodwa, bese ngesinye

Ekhibhodini ye-braille, bamba iminwe emithathu yesandla esisodwa esikrinini, bese ubeka iminwe emithathu yesinye isandla, futhi ugcine yonke iminwe eyisithupha ingahambi. Ukuze uvale lokhu, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, I-Braille, Ikhibhodi ye-braille.
Imiyalo
Ukuze wabele le miyalo ukunyakaza noma isinqamuleli sekhibhodi, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo.
Izinqamuleli zezinhlelo zokusebenza

Ivula izinqamuleli eziboniswa ukucindezela isikhathi eside isithonjana se-app esikrinini sasekhaya. Ukuze wengeze isinqamuleli esivela ku-app efana ne-MacroDroid, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Izinqamuleli zezinhlelo zokusebenza, bese ukhetha okuthi Engeza isinqamuleli sohlelo lokusebenza.
Sula umbhalo
Isusa wonke umbhalo ebhokisini lokuhlela eligxiliwe.
Vula noma vala ukuguqulwa kombala
Ivula noma ivale ukuguqulwa kombala kwe-Android. Lo myalo udinga i-Shizuku.
Sebenzisa iphrofayili yezwi
Ishintshela kokuthi Okuzenzakalelayo kwe-SandFly noma kuphrofayili yezwi eyodwa. Kukhona umyalo othi Sebenzisa iphrofayili yezwi wokuthi Okuzenzakalelayo kwe-SandFly nowephrofayili yezwi ngayinye.
Vula noma vala okokufaka kwekhibhodi ye-SandFly

Ngenkathi okokufaka kwekhibhodi ye-SandFly kuvaliwe, wonke ukhiye wekhibhodi engokoqobo uya ku-Android naku-app esephambili, ngaphandle kokhiye balo myalo: ukhiye we-SandFly + Shift + K, noma ukhiye we-SandFly + Shift + Ikhefanangqi kumamephu okhiye e-VoiceOver ne-Orca.
Vala i-SandFly

Ivala i-SandFly ngemuva kokuthi uqinisekise, futhi ibuyisela ukuphathwa kokuthinta ku-Android, ukuze isifundi sesikrini esilandelayo, esifana ne-TalkBack, sithole ukuthinta kwakho. Lo myalo uphinde ube semenyu ye-SandFly.
I-AI nokubhalisa ngezwi
Isilawuli sokufunda esithi Izenzo ze-AI

Swayiphela phezulu noma phansi ukuze ukhethe okuthi Chaza isikrini, Chaza isithombe, noma omunye wemiyalo ethi Isho nethi Buza, bese uthepha kabili ukuze uyiqalise. Ukuze ukhethe izenzo ezisesilawulini sokufunda, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Izilawuli zokufunda, Izenzo ze-AI ezifakiwe.
Imiyalo ethi Isho nethi Buza

Okuthi Isho incazelo yesikrini nokuthi Isho incazelo yesithombe kusho incazelo esikhundleni sokuyibonisa ewindini. Okuthi Buza ngesikrini nokuthi Buza ngesithombe kuthatha isithombe-skrini, bese kuqopha umbuzo wakho ngokubhalisa ngezwi, futhi i-SandFly isho impendulo. Imiyalo ikokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini.
Bika impendulo ye-AI
Ivula umbiko wenkinga onombhalo wempendulo yokugcina ye-AI, wempendulo ehlambalazayo noma engalungile. Umyalo ukokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini.
Ifayela lemodeli

Ukuze usebenzise ifayela lemodeli ye-whisper.cpp yakho ekubhaliseni ngezwi, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ukubhalisa ngezwi, bese ngaphansi kokuthi Amamodeli e-Whisper, ukhethe okuthi Ifayela lemodeli.
Imiyalelo yokulungisa
Ukuze ushintshe imiyalelo isevisi ye-AI eyitholayo yokulungisa okubhaliswe ngezwi, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ukubhalisa ngezwi, Imiyalelo yokulungisa.
Susa le divayisi

Ukuze usebenzise ikhodi yakho ye-SandFly Pro kwenye idivayisi, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, SandFly Pro, bese ukhetha okuthi Susa le divayisi. I-SandFly Pro iyavaleka kule divayisi, futhi ungenza ikhodi isebenze kwenye idivayisi.
Ezinye izakhi
Sesha

Okuthi Sesha, phezulu esikrinini esiyinhloko samasethingi, kuthola amasethingi nemiyalo kuso sonke isikrini samasethingi. Okuthi Sesha kuphinde kube phezulu kokuthi Ukunyakaza, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi nohlu lwemiyalo yokunyakaza.
Iya kumlayezo ocashunwe
Ku-Telegram, izenzo zomlayezo ophendula omunye zihlanganisa okuthi Iya kumlayezo ocashunwe, okubonisa umlayezo ocashunwe.
Bonisa inkomba yokugxila
Ukuze ufihle uhlaka oluzungeze into egxiliwe, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Isibonisi, Inkomba yokugxila, bese uvala okuthi Bonisa inkomba yokugxila.
Iziskripthi

Iziskripthi manje zingasebenzisa ukunyakaza kwasemaphethelweni, ukuncinza, ukunweba, ukukhuhla ngeminwe emibili nokuswayipha bese ubamba, zishintshe isihloko nesifinyezo sesethingi leskripthi, futhi zithumele wonke ukhiye ku-app.
